capabilities: Extract knowledge chunks from notes using an LLM
Update existing chunks incrementally when a note changes
Schedule chunk reviews with the SM2 spaced-repetition algorithm
Review chunks via AI conversation or manual star grading
Create custom extraction and review templates
extras: Requires an LLM API key and consumes API credits; review quality depends on model choice (README recommends GPT-4 for better extraction).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to break notes into reviewable knowledge chunks or schedule spaced-repetition review of them.

relations.evidence: Supports OpenAI API and compatible APIs (e.g., Alibaba Cloud DashScope)

summary: AI plugin that extracts knowledge chunks from notes with an LLM and schedules spaced-repetition reviews using the SM2 algorithm.
